name: ordax-chatgpt
description: Connect ChatGPT to an authorized ORDAX device for grant-scoped projects, typed Computer Control, files, Git and specialized adapters.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to the ORDAX device you explicitly authorize. This ChatGPT connector exposes grant-scoped typed tools for screens and windows, bounded desktop interaction, locally allowlisted applications, processes, authorized files and Git, managed browser tooling, and durable project continuity. Blender and Unity are specialized project adapters. The connector does not own ORDAX Studio or the Runtime: every remote action remains limited by device, scope and action grants plus local Runtime policy, and the integration does not request unrestricted conversation history or silently bypass local permissions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-review package for the ORDAX for ChatGPT connector with grant-scoped typed Computer Control, projects, files, Git, durable context, production OAuth, local Runtime policy and specialized adapters.

pt-BR.subtitle: Use o ORDAX no ChatGPT
pt-BR.description: Conecte o ChatGPT ao dispositivo autorizado pelo ORDAX. O conector usa ações tipadas e grants para tela, janelas, entrada controlada, aplicativos permitidos localmente, processos, arquivos, Git e continuidade de projetos. Blender e Unity são adapters especializados. O Runtime e a política local continuam limitando cada ação por dispositivo, escopo e permissão.
